question: In which of the following Indian states will you find the ‘Kunchikal Falls’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

__
 
• **The Kunchikal falls located in the state of Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kunchikal Falls** is located in **Nidagodu village** near **Masthikatte** in **Shimoga district** of state** Karnataka**.

 
 
• **Kunchikal falls **is formed by the Varahi River.
 
• **Kunchikal falls **cascade down r**ocky boulders** and the total height of the fall is **455 meters.**
